shared_elements: monolithic anthropomorphic figure with heavy blocky head and torso
low-relief carvings applied to the dorsal/back surface of the figure
curvilinear ring or oval motifs in shallow relief
broad flat body panel used as a field for shallow incised/relief designs
strongly schematic, angular treatment of the head and brow
justification: Both depict a massive, highly schematic anthropomorphic figure with a blocky elongated head and heavy brow, whose back/torso serves as a panel for shallow low-relief curvilinear and ring-like motifs — a fairly specific combination of statue-plus-dorsal-relief rather than a generic figure. The difference is that B's reliefs are legible and specific (paired symmetrical creatures flanking a central ring, a girdle band, discrete discs in ordered registers) while A's carvings are faint, sparse and unresolved, so the specific motif content and its symmetry cannot be matched element for element.
